### 词群 21.05｜辨认内脏与腔体 {#group-21-05}

**串联方式：** 把器官、肝、胃、子宫、肾、肺、腺体、腔室和肠道放到身体位置图上。

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="21-049">
<summary><h4 id="word-21-049" class="vocabulary-word-title">organ<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-21-049" aria-label="定位 organ">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="21-049" data-mark-label="organ" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="organ：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="organ：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=organ&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 organ" title="在有道查询 organ">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">21-049</span></span></summary>
<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">n.器官；风琴；机构</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">

<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The physiology exhibit covers the <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=pulse&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>pulse</strong></a>, the path of an artery, the function of a nerve and hormone regulation.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">生理展览涵盖脉搏、动脉走向、神经功能及激素调节。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The doctor recorded her <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=pulse&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>pulse</strong></a> and explained a diagram showing an artery, a nerve and a hormone-producing gland.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">医生记录了她的脉搏，并解释一幅显示动脉、神经及分泌激素的腺体的图。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The textbook separates <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=pulse&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>pulse</strong></a> measurement from artery anatomy, nerve signalling and hormone analysis.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">教材将脉搏测量与动脉解剖、神经信号及激素分析分开讲解。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">check a pulse</span> · 测脉搏</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=physiology&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">physiology</a></span> · 生理学</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=body%20signals&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">body signals</a></span> · 身体信号</li></ul>

<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The visual display remains visible from every seat, giving people with poor eyesight a better view and a clearer line of <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=sight&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>sight</strong></a>.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">视觉显示屏从每个座位都能看见，为视力不佳者提供更好的视野和更清楚的视线。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A clear view matters for <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=sight&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>sight</strong></a>-based tasks, so visual signs should be visible to people with limited eyesight.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">清晰视野对依靠视觉的任务很重要，因此视觉标识应让视力受限者看见。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The designer tested whether the visual map was visible from a seated view and readable for someone with poor eyesight or restricted <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=sight&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>sight</strong></a>.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">设计师测试了视觉地图能否从坐姿视角看见，以及视力不佳或视野受限者能否阅读。</p></li>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="21-082">

<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">adj. 含糊的；不清楚的，模糊的</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=vague&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>vague</strong></a> warning left him blind to the danger, and the sudden failure struck him dumb.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">含糊警告使他未察觉危险，突然的失败让他惊得说不出话。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">She was struck dumb when a <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=vague&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>vague</strong></a> promise proved that managers had been blind to the problem.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">她发现含糊承诺表明经理一直未察觉问题时，惊得说不出话。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=vague&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>vague</strong></a> explanation can leave an audience blind to the facts and a worried speaker struck dumb.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">含糊解释可能使听众不了解事实，并让担忧的演讲者说不出话。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">a vague explanation</span> · 含糊解释</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=uncertainty&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">uncertainty</a></span> · 不确定性</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=speechlessness&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">speechlessness</a></span> · 说不出话</li></ul>
</div>
</details>

<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">adj. 盲目的；瞎的；未察觉的</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The vague warning left him <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=blind&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>blind</strong></a> to the danger, and the sudden failure struck him dumb.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">含糊警告使他未察觉危险，突然的失败让他惊得说不出话。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">She was struck dumb when a vague promise proved that managers had been <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=blind&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>blind</strong></a> to the problem.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">她发现含糊承诺表明经理一直未察觉问题时，惊得说不出话。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A vague explanation can leave an audience <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=blind&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>blind</strong></a> to the facts and a worried speaker struck dumb.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">含糊解释可能使听众不了解事实，并让担忧的演讲者说不出话。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">blind to a risk</span> · 未察觉风险</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=uncertainty&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">uncertainty</a></span> · 不确定性</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=speechlessness&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">speechlessness</a></span> · 说不出话</li></ul>
</div>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">She was struck <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=dumb&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>dumb</strong></a> when a vague promise proved that managers had been blind to the problem.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">她发现含糊承诺表明经理一直未察觉问题时，惊得说不出话。</p></li>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A yawn told us he was struggling to remain <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=awake&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>awake</strong></a> and wanted a nap.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">一个呵欠告诉我们，他正努力不睡着，并想小睡。</p></li>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The novel depicts a doctor listening to a moan, recording each <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=symptom&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>symptom</strong></a> and explaining the difference between a reported illness and a diagnosed disease.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">小说描写医生听呻吟、记录每个症状，并解释主观病感与确诊疾病的区别。</p></li>
</ol>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The memoir follows recovery from a heart attack and an <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=infection&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>infection</strong></a>, and describes working to the detriment of personal wellbeing.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">回忆录记录心脏病发作及感染后的康复，并描述不顾个人健康地工作。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The hospital reviewed a case involving an <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=infection&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>infection</strong></a> after a heart attack to ensure paperwork had not delayed care to the detriment of the patient.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">医院审查了一起心脏病发作后感染的病例，确认文书工作没有延误护理、损害病人利益。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The article discusses the cost of treating <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=infection&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>infection</strong></a> and heart attack without cutting prevention to the detriment of public health.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">文章讨论治疗感染和心脏病发作的费用，同时强调不应削减预防、损害公共健康。</p></li>
</ol>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The article discusses the cost of treating infection and heart attack without cutting prevention to the <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=detriment&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>detriment</strong></a> of public health.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">文章讨论治疗感染和心脏病发作的费用，同时强调不应削减预防、损害公共健康。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">to the detriment of</span> · 有损于</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=patient%20welfare&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">patient welfare</a></span> · 病人福祉</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=recovery&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">recovery</a></span> · 康复</li></ul>

### 词群 21.11｜常见疾病与不适表现 {#group-21-11}

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="21-133">
<summary><h4 id="word-21-133" class="vocabulary-word-title">hurt<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-21-133" aria-label="定位 hurt">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="21-133" data-mark-label="hurt" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="hurt：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="hurt：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=hurt&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 hurt" title="在有道查询 hurt">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">21-133</span></span></summary>
<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">v.损害；伤害；（使）疼痛</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Unsafe equipment can injure workers, and even a minor injury may <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=hurt&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>hurt</strong></a> for weeks.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">不安全设备可能伤害工人，即使轻伤也可能疼数周。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The safety review asked how the machine could injure a hand, what injury resulted and how much it <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=hurt&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>hurt</strong></a>.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">安全审查询问机器如何可能伤手、造成什么伤害，以及有多疼。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The actor pretended to injure his arm, showing how the fictional injury would <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=hurt&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>hurt</strong></a> when he moved.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">演员假装手臂受伤，表现虚构伤情在活动时会如何疼痛。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">hurt a shoulder</span> · 使肩膀疼痛</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=workplace%20safety&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">workplace safety</a></span> · 职场安全</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=accident&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">accident</a></span> · 事故</li></ul>
</div>
</details>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="21-138">
<summary><h4 id="word-21-138" class="vocabulary-word-title">trauma<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-21-138" aria-label="定位 trauma">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="21-138" data-mark-label="trauma" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="trauma：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="trauma：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=trauma&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 trauma" title="在有道查询 trauma">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">21-138</span></span></summary>
<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">n. 外伤，身体上的伤；精神创伤；痛苦经历</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The patient described pain around a lump and asked whether earlier <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=trauma&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>trauma</strong></a> might explain it.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">病人描述了肿块周围的疼痛，并询问是否可能由先前外伤解释。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The report separates physical <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=trauma&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>trauma</strong></a> and pain from the investigation of an unrelated lump.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">报告将身体外伤及疼痛与一处无关肿块的检查分开记录。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The actor conveyed <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=trauma&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>trauma</strong></a> through his voice while describing a painful lump and the character's fear of more pain.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">演员用声音表现创伤，同时描述疼痛肿块以及角色对更多疼痛的恐惧。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">psychological trauma</span> · 心理创伤</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=clinical%20history&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">clinical history</a></span> · 临床病史</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=distress&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">distress</a></span> · 痛苦</li></ul>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="21-139">

<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">n. 块；肿块；v. 使成块状</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The patient described pain around a <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=lump&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>lump</strong></a> and asked whether earlier trauma might explain it.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">病人描述了肿块周围的疼痛，并询问是否可能由先前外伤解释。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The report separates physical trauma and pain from the investigation of an unrelated <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=lump&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>lump</strong></a>.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">报告将身体外伤及疼痛与一处无关肿块的检查分开记录。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The actor conveyed trauma through his voice while describing a painful <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=lump&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>lump</strong></a> and the character's fear of more pain.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">演员用声音表现创伤，同时描述疼痛肿块以及角色对更多疼痛的恐惧。</p></li>

<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The report follows people seeking health care, from an <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=uncomfortable&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>uncomfortable</strong></a> waiting room to support for an unconscious patient.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">报告跟踪人们求医的过程，从令人不适的候诊室到对无意识病人的照护。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Health care staff reassured the <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=uncomfortable&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>uncomfortable</strong></a> visitor while explaining why her unconscious relative was being monitored.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">医疗人员安慰不自在的访客，并解释为何监测其无意识亲属。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The documentary explores health care through the story of an unconscious patient and a family member <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=uncomfortable&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>uncomfortable</strong></a> with medical settings.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">纪录片通过一个无意识病人及不适应医疗环境的家属的故事，探讨医疗服务。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">feel uncomfortable</span> · 感觉不舒服</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=patient%20support&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">patient support</a></span> · 病人支持</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=care%20setting&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">care setting</a></span> · 医疗环境</li></ul>

<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">adj. 慢性的；长期的</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The clinician distinguished the <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=chronic&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>chronic</strong></a> condition from an acute episode and separately noted a sore throat.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">临床医生区分了慢性疾病与急性发作，并另行记录喉咙痛。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The case notes describe <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=chronic&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>chronic</strong></a> back pain, an acute injury and a sore shoulder.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">病历描述了慢性背痛、急性损伤及肩部疼痛。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The course uses separate examples of <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=chronic&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>chronic</strong></a> illness, acute distress and a sore throat.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">课程分别使用慢性病、急性痛苦和喉咙痛的例子。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">a chronic condition</span> · 慢性疾病</p>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="21-160">

<p class="vocabulary-meaning">adj. (疾病）急性的；敏锐的，深刻的</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The clinician distinguished the chronic condition from an <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=acute&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>acute</strong></a> episode and separately noted a sore throat.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">临床医生区分了慢性疾病与急性发作，并另行记录喉咙痛。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The case notes describe chronic back pain, an <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=acute&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>acute</strong></a> injury and a sore shoulder.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">病历描述了慢性背痛、急性损伤及肩部疼痛。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The course uses separate examples of chronic illness, <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=acute&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>acute</strong></a> distress and a sore throat.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">课程分别使用慢性病、急性痛苦和喉咙痛的例子。</p></li>

<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The plan includes a <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=precaution&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>precaution</strong></a> to segregate waste, procedures to isolate samples and quarantine arrivals, and proposals to vaccinate staff.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">计划包括分类隔离废物的预防措施、分离样本与对抵达者实施检疫的程序，以及为员工接种的提议。</p></li>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Before they vaccinate volunteers, officials explain each <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=precaution&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>precaution</strong></a>, including when to quarantine contacts, isolate specimens and segregate laboratory waste.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">志愿者接种前，官员解释各项预防措施，包括何时检疫接触者、分离样本及分类隔离实验室废物。</p></li>
</ol>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Before they vaccinate volunteers, officials explain each precaution, including when to quarantine contacts, <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=isolate&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>isolate</strong></a> specimens and segregate laboratory waste.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">志愿者接种前，官员解释各项预防措施，包括何时检疫接触者、分离样本及分类隔离实验室废物。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">isolate a sample</span> · 分离样本</p>

<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">During <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=recovery&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>recovery</strong></a>, a quiet garden helped refresh her mind, relieve stress and alleviate loneliness, bringing a sense of relief.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">康复期间，安静花园帮助她恢复精神、减轻压力和孤独，带来宽慰。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The charity offers relief during <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=recovery&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>recovery</strong></a> through visits that refresh the spirit, relieve boredom and alleviate isolation.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">慈善机构通过探访在康复期间提供慰藉，让人精神振作、减轻无聊和孤立。</p></li>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A small improvement can please a learner, but passing the final exam may make the whole family <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=rejoice&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>rejoice</strong></a>.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">一点进步就能让学习者高兴，而通过期末考试可能让全家欢庆。</p></li>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">An <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=earnest&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>earnest</strong></a> commitment to honesty should accompany a rational approach to criticism.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">认真坚持诚实的态度，应与理性面对批评的方式相结合。</p></li>
</ol>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=considerate&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>considerate</strong></a> nurse offered a thoughtful response and a sympathetic smile.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">这位体贴的护士给出了周到的回应和富有同情心的微笑。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A sympathetic listener can be both thoughtful and <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=considerate&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>considerate</strong></a> without giving advice.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">一个善于共情的倾听者即使不提供建议，也可以周到体贴。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Her thoughtful message revealed a <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=considerate&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>considerate</strong></a> and sympathetic approach to the family’s difficulties.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">她周到的信息体现了对这个家庭困境的体谅和同情。</p></li>
</ol>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A sympathetic listener can be both <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=thoughtful&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>thoughtful</strong></a> and considerate without giving advice.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">一个善于共情的倾听者即使不提供建议，也可以周到体贴。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Her <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=thoughtful&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>thoughtful</strong></a> message revealed a considerate and sympathetic approach to the family’s difficulties.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">她周到的信息体现了对这个家庭困境的体谅和同情。</p></li>
</ol>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=sympathetic&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>sympathetic</strong></a> listener can be both thoughtful and considerate without giving advice.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">一个善于共情的倾听者即使不提供建议，也可以周到体贴。</p></li>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="21-276">
<summary><h4 id="word-21-276" class="vocabulary-word-title">ready<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-21-276" aria-label="定位 ready">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="21-276" data-mark-label="ready" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="ready：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="ready：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=ready&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 ready" title="在有道查询 ready">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">21-276</span></span></summary>
<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">adj.准备好的；愿意的</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">She was <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=ready&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>ready</strong></a> to apologise and hoped that her apology would repair the friendship.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">她准备好道歉，希望自己的道歉能修复友谊。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">An apology matters more when the speaker is <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=ready&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>ready</strong></a> to explain why they need to apologise.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">当说话者愿意说明自己为何需要道歉时，道歉才更有意义。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Before you apologise, be <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=ready&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>ready</strong></a> to listen to the response rather than simply repeat your apology.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">道歉前，要做好倾听回应的准备，而不是仅仅重复道歉。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">ready to help</span> · 乐于帮助</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=reconciliation&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">reconciliation</a></span> · 和解</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=forgiveness&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">forgiveness</a></span> · 原谅</li></ul>
</div>
</details>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="21-277">
<summary><h4 id="word-21-277" class="vocabulary-word-title">apologise<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-21-277" aria-label="定位 apologise">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="21-277" data-mark-label="apologise" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="apologise：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="apologise：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=apologise&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 apologise" title="在有道查询 apologise">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">21-277</span></span></summary>
<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">(=apologize)；v.道歉，赔罪</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">She was ready to <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=apologise&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>apologise</strong></a> and hoped that her apology would repair the friendship.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">她准备好道歉，希望自己的道歉能修复友谊。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">An apology matters more when the speaker is ready to explain why they need to <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=apologise&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>apologise</strong></a>.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">当说话者愿意说明自己为何需要道歉时，道歉才更有意义。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Before you <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=apologise&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>apologise</strong></a>, be ready to listen to the response rather than simply repeat your apology.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">道歉前，要做好倾听回应的准备，而不是仅仅重复道歉。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">apologise for a mistake</span> · 为错误道歉</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=reconciliation&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">reconciliation</a></span> · 和解</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=forgiveness&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">forgiveness</a></span> · 原谅</li></ul>
</div>
</details>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">An <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=apology&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>apology</strong></a> matters more when the speaker is ready to explain why they need to apologise.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">当说话者愿意说明自己为何需要道歉时，道歉才更有意义。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Before you apologise, be ready to listen to the response rather than simply repeat your <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=apology&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>apology</strong></a>.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">道歉前，要做好倾听回应的准备，而不是仅仅重复道歉。</p></li>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="21-279">
<summary><h4 id="word-21-279" class="vocabulary-word-title">mercy<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-21-279" aria-label="定位 mercy">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="21-279" data-mark-label="mercy" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="mercy：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="mercy：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=mercy&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 mercy" title="在有道查询 mercy">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">21-279</span></span></summary>

<p class="vocabulary-meaning">n.仁慈，宽容，怜悯</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">We admire the remarkable <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=mercy&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>mercy</strong></a> she showed towards her former opponent.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">我们钦佩她对昔日对手表现出的非凡宽容。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The story invites readers to admire a remarkable act of <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=mercy&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>mercy</strong></a>.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">这个故事让读者赞赏一次非凡的仁慈之举。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Her remarkable courage is easy to admire, but her <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=mercy&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>mercy</strong></a> deserves equal attention.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">她非凡的勇气容易令人钦佩，但她的仁慈同样值得关注。</p></li>
</ol>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="21-280">

<p class="vocabulary-meaning">v.赞美，钦佩，仰慕</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">We <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=admire&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>admire</strong></a> the remarkable mercy she showed towards her former opponent.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">我们钦佩她对昔日对手表现出的非凡宽容。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The story invites readers to <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=admire&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>admire</strong></a> a remarkable act of mercy.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">这个故事让读者赞赏一次非凡的仁慈之举。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Her remarkable courage is easy to <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=admire&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>admire</strong></a>, but her mercy deserves equal attention.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">她非凡的勇气容易令人钦佩，但她的仁慈同样值得关注。</p></li>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The story shows how people who <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=hate&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>hate</strong></a> injustice can still reject hatred towards individuals.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">故事展现了憎恶不公的人如何仍然拒绝仇视具体的人。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">He admitted that he used to <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=hate&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>hate</strong></a> his rival, although his hatred had faded over time.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">他承认自己过去憎恨对手，但这种仇恨已随时间淡去。</p></li>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=troublesome&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>troublesome</strong></a> interruptions began to bother the speaker and bore the listeners.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">这些烦人的打断开始困扰讲者，也让听众感到无聊。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">He did not want to bore his guests or bother them with <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=troublesome&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>troublesome</strong></a> details.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">他不想让客人厌烦，也不想用麻烦的细节打扰他们。</p></li>
</ol>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">An <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=awful&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>awful</strong></a> smell made the room unpleasant, while poor ventilation had an adverse impact on comfort.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">难闻的气味使房间令人不适，通风不良则降低了舒适度。</p></li>

</ol>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="21-327">

<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">adj.怀有敌意的，不友善的；敌对的</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The radical proposal met a <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=hostile&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>hostile</strong></a> response from an indignant committee.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">这项激进提议遭到了愤愤不平的委员会的敌对回应。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">An indignant resident challenged the <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=hostile&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>hostile</strong></a> tone of the debate about radical reform.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">一位愤愤不平的居民质疑了关于激进改革的辩论中的敌对语气。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The editor warned that a <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=hostile&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>hostile</strong></a> account of radical change could leave readers indignant.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">编辑提醒说，对激进变革怀有敌意的报道可能使读者愤慨。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">a hostile reception</span> · 敌意的接待</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=opposition&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">opposition</a></span> · 反对</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=controversy&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">controversy</a></span> · 争议</li></ul>
</div>
</details>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">An <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=indignant&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>indignant</strong></a> resident challenged the hostile tone of the debate about radical reform.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">一位愤愤不平的居民质疑了关于激进改革的辩论中的敌对语气。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The editor warned that a hostile account of radical change could leave readers <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=indignant&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>indignant</strong></a>.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">编辑提醒说，对激进变革怀有敌意的报道可能使读者愤慨。</p></li>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="21-330">
<summary><h4 id="word-21-330" class="vocabulary-word-title">mad<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-21-330" aria-label="定位 mad">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="21-330" data-mark-label="mad" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="mad：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="mad：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=mad&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 mad" title="在有道查询 mad">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">21-330</span></span></summary>

<p class="vocabulary-meaning">adj.发疯的；恼火的</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="21-336">

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="21-339">

<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=rash&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>rash</strong></a> decision in a volatile situation can lead to a weird result.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">在不稳定的局面下草率作决定，可能导致古怪的结果。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The volatile leader made a <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=rash&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>rash</strong></a> promise after hearing a weird rumour.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">这位情绪多变的领导者听到一个古怪的传闻后，草率作出了许诺。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A weird reaction from the volatile crowd prompted a <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=rash&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>rash</strong></a> response from the organiser.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">人群情绪多变而古怪的反应，促使组织者草率回应。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">a rash decision</span> · 草率的决定</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=impulsive&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">impulsive</a></span> · 冲动的</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=unpredictable&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">unpredictable</a></span> · 难以预测的</li></ul>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=volatile&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>volatile</strong></a> leader made a rash promise after hearing a weird rumour.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">这位情绪多变的领导者听到一个古怪的传闻后，草率作出了许诺。</p></li>

### 词群 21.30｜嫉妒、怀疑与不愿行动 {#group-21-30}

**串联方式：** 从羡慕嫉妒进入怀疑，再评价不稳定、不合适，并描述不愿、勉强与犹豫。

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="21-350">
<summary><h4 id="word-21-350" class="vocabulary-word-title">envy<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-21-350" aria-label="定位 envy">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="21-350" data-mark-label="envy" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="envy：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="envy：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=envy&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 envy" title="在有道查询 envy">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">21-350</span></span></summary>
<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">v.羡慕；嫉妒；n.羡慕；嫉妒</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">He felt jealous of his colleague but tried not to let <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=envy&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>envy</strong></a> affect their friendship.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">他嫉妒同事，却努力不让嫉妒影响两人的友谊。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The jealous character admits her <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=envy&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>envy</strong></a> when she sees her friend’s success.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">这个嫉妒心强的人物看到朋友成功时，承认了自己的嫉妒。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">People may <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=envy&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>envy</strong></a> a successful artist without becoming jealous of every achievement.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">人们可能羡慕成功的艺术家，却不会嫉妒她的每项成就。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">envy someone’s success</span> · 羡慕某人的成功</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=admiration&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">admiration</a></span> · 钦佩</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=comparison&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">comparison</a></span> · 比较</li></ul>
</div>
</details>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=jealous&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>jealous</strong></a> character admits her envy when she sees her friend’s success.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">这个嫉妒心强的人物看到朋友成功时，承认了自己的嫉妒。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">People may envy a successful artist without becoming <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=jealous&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>jealous</strong></a> of every achievement.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">人们可能羡慕成功的艺术家，却不会嫉妒她的每项成就。</p></li>

<div class="vocabulary-word-content">

<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A sceptical reader expressed <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=doubt&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>doubt</strong></a> and suspicion about the anonymous report.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">一位持怀疑态度的读者对匿名报告表示疑虑和怀疑。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Her suspicion grew into <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=doubt&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>doubt</strong></a>, leaving her sceptical of the proposed explanation.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">她的怀疑发展成疑虑，使她不太相信所提出的解释。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The researcher remained sceptical, but insisted that <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=doubt&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>doubt</strong></a> and suspicion should lead to further checks.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">研究人员仍持怀疑态度，但坚持认为疑虑和猜疑应引导进一步核查。</p></li>
</ol>

<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=evidence&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">evidence</a></span> · 证据</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=verification&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">verification</a></span> · 核实</li></ul>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Her <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=suspicion&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>suspicion</strong></a> grew into doubt, leaving her sceptical of the proposed explanation.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">她的怀疑发展成疑虑，使她不太相信所提出的解释。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The researcher remained sceptical, but insisted that doubt and <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=suspicion&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>suspicion</strong></a> should lead to further checks.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">研究人员仍持怀疑态度，但坚持认为疑虑和猜疑应引导进一步核查。</p></li>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Her suspicion grew into doubt, leaving her <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=sceptical&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>sceptical</strong></a> of the proposed explanation.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">她的怀疑发展成疑虑，使她不太相信所提出的解释。</p></li>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The review called the software unstable, unsuitable for beginners and generally <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=unsatisfactory&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>unsatisfactory</strong></a>.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">评论认为软件不稳定、不适合初学者，而且总体表现不佳。</p></li>
</ol>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">An unsuitable support left the shelf <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=unstable&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>unstable</strong></a> and the repair unsatisfactory.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">不合适的支架使架子不稳，维修效果也不理想。</p></li>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="21-358">
<summary><h4 id="word-21-358" class="vocabulary-word-title">unwilling<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-21-358" aria-label="定位 unwilling">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="21-358" data-mark-label="unwilling" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="unwilling：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="unwilling：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=unwilling&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 unwilling" title="在有道查询 unwilling">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">21-358</span></span></summary>
<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">adj.不愿意的，不情愿的；勉强的</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">An <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=unwilling&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>unwilling</strong></a> participant may hesitate to speak and remain reluctant to join the discussion.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">不愿参与的人可能犹豫着不开口，并一直不情愿加入讨论。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">She was reluctant to sign, <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=unwilling&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>unwilling</strong></a> to commit and likely to hesitate until she had more information.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">她不情愿签字，也不愿作出承诺，很可能要等获得更多信息后才不再犹豫。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The reluctant witness was <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=unwilling&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>unwilling</strong></a> to guess and did not hesitate to admit uncertainty.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">这位不情愿的证人不愿猜测，并毫不犹豫地承认自己不确定。</p></li>
</ol>

<p class="vocabulary-meaning">adj.不情愿的；勉强的</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">An unwilling participant may hesitate to speak and remain <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=reluctant&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>reluctant</strong></a> to join the discussion.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">不愿参与的人可能犹豫着不开口，并一直不情愿加入讨论。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">She was <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=reluctant&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>reluctant</strong></a> to sign, unwilling to commit and likely to hesitate until she had more information.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">她不情愿签字，也不愿作出承诺，很可能要等获得更多信息后才不再犹豫。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=reluctant&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>reluctant</strong></a> witness was unwilling to guess and did not hesitate to admit uncertainty.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">这位不情愿的证人不愿猜测，并毫不犹豫地承认自己不确定。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">reluctant to change</span> · 不情愿改变</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=willingness&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">willingness</a></span> · 意愿</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=reservation&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">reservation</a></span> · 顾虑</li></ul>
</div>
</details>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="21-360">
<summary><h4 id="word-21-360" class="vocabulary-word-title">hesitate<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-21-360" aria-label="定位 hesitate">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="21-360" data-mark-label="hesitate" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="hesitate：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="hesitate：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=hesitate&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 hesitate" title="在有道查询 hesitate">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">21-360</span></span></summary>
<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">v.犹豫不决，踌躇；顾虑</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">An unwilling participant may <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=hesitate&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>hesitate</strong></a> to speak and remain reluctant to join the discussion.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">不愿参与的人可能犹豫着不开口，并一直不情愿加入讨论。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">She was reluctant to sign, unwilling to commit and likely to <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=hesitate&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>hesitate</strong></a> until she had more information.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">她不情愿签字，也不愿作出承诺，很可能要等获得更多信息后才不再犹豫。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The reluctant witness was unwilling to guess and did not <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=hesitate&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>hesitate</strong></a> to admit uncertainty.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">这位不情愿的证人不愿猜测，并毫不犹豫地承认自己不确定。</p></li>
</ol>

</div>

### 词群 21.31｜困惑、内疚与承受 {#group-21-31}

**串联方式：** 由困惑、内疚、尴尬、后悔和羞愧进入叹息、哭泣、容忍与忍受；ignorant 是无知。

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="21-361">
<summary><h4 id="word-21-361" class="vocabulary-word-title">confuse<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-21-361" aria-label="定位 confuse">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="21-361" data-mark-label="confuse" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="confuse：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="confuse：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=confuse&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 confuse" title="在有道查询 confuse">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">21-361</span></span></summary>
<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">v.使困惑，把(某人)弄糊涂混淆</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A careless accusation can <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=confuse&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>confuse</strong></a> an innocent person, embarrass them and make them feel guilty.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">草率的指责可能使无辜的人困惑、尴尬，并产生负罪感。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The investigator avoided questions that might <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=confuse&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>confuse</strong></a> or embarrass the witness rather than establish whether anyone was guilty.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">调查者避免提出只会让证人困惑或尴尬、却无助于确定是否有人有罪的问题。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The teacher did not want to <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=confuse&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>confuse</strong></a> the class or embarrass the student who already looked guilty.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">老师不想让全班困惑，也不想让那位已显得内疚的学生难堪。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">confuse two concepts</span> · 混淆两个概念</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=confusion&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">confusion</a></span> · 困惑</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=embarrassment&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">embarrassment</a></span> · 尴尬</li></ul>
</div>
</details>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="21-362">
<summary><h4 id="word-21-362" class="vocabulary-word-title">guilty<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-21-362" aria-label="定位 guilty">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="21-362" data-mark-label="guilty" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="guilty：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="guilty：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=guilty&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 guilty" title="在有道查询 guilty">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">21-362</span></span></summary>
<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">adj.有罪的；内疚的</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A careless accusation can confuse an innocent person, embarrass them and make them feel <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=guilty&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>guilty</strong></a>.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">草率的指责可能使无辜的人困惑、尴尬，并产生负罪感。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The investigator avoided questions that might confuse or embarrass the witness rather than establish whether anyone was <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=guilty&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>guilty</strong></a>.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">调查者避免提出只会让证人困惑或尴尬、却无助于确定是否有人有罪的问题。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The teacher did not want to confuse the class or embarrass the student who already looked <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=guilty&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>guilty</strong></a>.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">老师不想让全班困惑，也不想让那位已显得内疚的学生难堪。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">feel guilty</span> · 感到内疚</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=confusion&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">confusion</a></span> · 困惑</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=embarrassment&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">embarrassment</a></span> · 尴尬</li></ul>
</div>
</details>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="21-363">
<summary><h4 id="word-21-363" class="vocabulary-word-title">embarrass<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-21-363" aria-label="定位 embarrass">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="21-363" data-mark-label="embarrass" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="embarrass：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="embarrass：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=embarrass&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 embarrass" title="在有道查询 embarrass">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">21-363</span></span></summary>
<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">v.使尴尬，使窘迫，使局促不安</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A careless accusation can confuse an innocent person, <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=embarrass&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>embarrass</strong></a> them and make them feel guilty.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">草率的指责可能使无辜的人困惑、尴尬，并产生负罪感。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The investigator avoided questions that might confuse or <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=embarrass&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>embarrass</strong></a> the witness rather than establish whether anyone was guilty.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">调查者避免提出只会让证人困惑或尴尬、却无助于确定是否有人有罪的问题。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The teacher did not want to confuse the class or <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=embarrass&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>embarrass</strong></a> the student who already looked guilty.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">老师不想让全班困惑，也不想让那位已显得内疚的学生难堪。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">embarrass a guest</span> · 使客人尴尬</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=confusion&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">confusion</a></span> · 困惑</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=embarrassment&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">embarrassment</a></span> · 尴尬</li></ul>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="21-364">
<summary><h4 id="word-21-364" class="vocabulary-word-title">regret<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-21-364" aria-label="定位 regret">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="21-364" data-mark-label="regret" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="regret：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="regret：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=regret&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 regret" title="在有道查询 regret">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">21-364</span></span></summary>
<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">n.遗憾；抱歉；悲叹；v.后悔痛惜，惋惜</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">She felt ashamed of the remark and began to <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=regret&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>regret</strong></a> it, hoping to repent through better behaviour.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">她为那句话感到羞愧，开始后悔，希望通过改善行为表达悔改。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The story asks whether a character who feels ashamed and full of <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=regret&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>regret</strong></a> will truly repent.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">故事追问一个感到羞愧且满怀遗憾的人物是否会真正悔改。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">He was ashamed to admit his <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=regret&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>regret</strong></a> but knew that he needed to repent of his cruelty.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">他羞于承认自己的后悔，却知道自己需要为残忍行为悔改。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">regret a decision</span> · 后悔作出某个决定</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=remorse&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">remorse</a></span> · 懊悔</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=amend&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">amend</a></span> · 改正</li></ul>
</div>
</details>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="21-365">
<summary><h4 id="word-21-365" class="vocabulary-word-title">repent<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-21-365" aria-label="定位 repent">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="21-365" data-mark-label="repent" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="repent：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="repent：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=repent&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 repent" title="在有道查询 repent">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">21-365</span></span></summary>
<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">v.忏悔；后悔</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">She felt ashamed of the remark and began to regret it, hoping to <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=repent&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>repent</strong></a> through better behaviour.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">她为那句话感到羞愧，开始后悔，希望通过改善行为表达悔改。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The story asks whether a character who feels ashamed and full of regret will truly <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=repent&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>repent</strong></a>.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">故事追问一个感到羞愧且满怀遗憾的人物是否会真正悔改。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">He was ashamed to admit his regret but knew that he needed to <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=repent&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>repent</strong></a> of his cruelty.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">他羞于承认自己的后悔，却知道自己需要为残忍行为悔改。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">repent of wrongdoing</span> · 为过错悔改</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=remorse&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">remorse</a></span> · 懊悔</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=amend&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">amend</a></span> · 改正</li></ul>
</div>
</details>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="21-366">
<summary><h4 id="word-21-366" class="vocabulary-word-title">ashamed<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-21-366" aria-label="定位 ashamed">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="21-366" data-mark-label="ashamed" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="ashamed：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="ashamed：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=ashamed&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 ashamed" title="在有道查询 ashamed">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">21-366</span></span></summary>
<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">adj.惭愧的，感到难为情的；耻于……的</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">She felt <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=ashamed&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>ashamed</strong></a> of the remark and began to regret it, hoping to repent through better behaviour.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">她为那句话感到羞愧，开始后悔，希望通过改善行为表达悔改。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The story asks whether a character who feels <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=ashamed&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>ashamed</strong></a> and full of regret will truly repent.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">故事追问一个感到羞愧且满怀遗憾的人物是否会真正悔改。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">He was <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=ashamed&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>ashamed</strong></a> to admit his regret but knew that he needed to repent of his cruelty.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">他羞于承认自己的后悔，却知道自己需要为残忍行为悔改。</p></li>

<p class="vocabulary-meaning">n.忍受，容忍，宽容</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">It takes <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=tolerance&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>tolerance</strong></a> to endure criticism from someone who is ignorant of the facts.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">忍受一个不了解事实的人的批评，需要宽容。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">She showed <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=tolerance&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>tolerance</strong></a> towards the ignorant visitor but refused to endure repeated insults.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">她对无知的游客表现出宽容，却拒绝忍受一再的侮辱。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The novel explores the <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=tolerance&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>tolerance</strong></a> required to endure a society that remains ignorant of a minority’s experience.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">小说探讨了忍受一个仍不了解少数群体经历的社会所需的宽容。</p></li>
</ol>
