### 词群 21.32｜行为与性格的负面描述 {#group-21-32}

**串联方式：** 把狡猾专断、愚蠢笨拙、粗心健忘、顽皮贪婪、懒散冲动和僵化固执分成小簇。

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="21-372">
<summary><h4 id="word-21-372" class="vocabulary-word-title">sly<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-21-372" aria-label="定位 sly">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="21-372" data-mark-label="sly" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="sly：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="sly：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=sly&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 sly" title="在有道查询 sly">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">21-372</span></span></summary>
<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">adj.狡猾的，狡诈的</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The cunning official used a <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=sly&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>sly</strong></a> smile to disguise an arbitrary decision.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">狡猾的官员用狡黠的微笑掩饰一个武断的决定。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=sly&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>sly</strong></a> and cunning character can exploit arbitrary rules for personal gain.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">一个狡猾而诡计多端的人物可能利用随意的规则谋取私利。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The reviewer described the villain as cunning and <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=sly&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>sly</strong></a>, but called the plot’s ending arbitrary.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">评论者称反派狡猾诡诈，却认为情节结尾很随意。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">a sly smile</span> · 狡黠的微笑</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=deception&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">deception</a></span> · 欺骗</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=manipulation&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">manipulation</a></span> · 操纵</li></ul>
</div>
</details>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="21-373">
<summary><h4 id="word-21-373" class="vocabulary-word-title">cunning<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-21-373" aria-label="定位 cunning">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="21-373" data-mark-label="cunning" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="cunning：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="cunning：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=cunning&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 cunning" title="在有道查询 cunning">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">21-373</span></span></summary>
<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">n.狡猾的；巧妙的</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=cunning&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>cunning</strong></a> official used a sly smile to disguise an arbitrary decision.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">狡猾的官员用狡黠的微笑掩饰一个武断的决定。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A sly and <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=cunning&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>cunning</strong></a> character can exploit arbitrary rules for personal gain.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">一个狡猾而诡计多端的人物可能利用随意的规则谋取私利。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The reviewer described the villain as <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=cunning&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>cunning</strong></a> and sly, but called the plot’s ending arbitrary.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">评论者称反派狡猾诡诈，却认为情节结尾很随意。</p></li>
</ol>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A sly and cunning character can exploit <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=arbitrary&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>arbitrary</strong></a> rules for personal gain.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">一个狡猾而诡计多端的人物可能利用随意的规则谋取私利。</p></li>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="21-375">

<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">adj.荒谬的，可笑的</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The film makes a <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=ridiculous&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>ridiculous</strong></a> plan look stupid even to its own inventor.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">电影让一个荒谬计划连在其发明者眼中都显得愚蠢。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">She rejected the <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=ridiculous&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>ridiculous</strong></a> claim without calling the person who made it stupid.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">她驳斥了这个荒谬说法，却没有称提出它的人愚蠢。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A stupid mistake can have a serious cost even when it seems <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=ridiculous&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>ridiculous</strong></a> in hindsight.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">愚蠢的错误即使事后看来可笑，也可能造成严重代价。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">a ridiculous claim</span> · 荒谬的说法</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=absurd&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">absurd</a></span> · 荒谬的</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=error&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">error</a></span> · 错误</li></ul>
</div>
</details>

<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">adj.愚蠢的；麻木的；乏味的；n.傻瓜，笨蛋</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The film makes a ridiculous plan look <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=stupid&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>stupid</strong></a> even to its own inventor.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">电影让一个荒谬计划连在其发明者眼中都显得愚蠢。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">She rejected the ridiculous claim without calling the person who made it <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=stupid&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>stupid</strong></a>.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">她驳斥了这个荒谬说法，却没有称提出它的人愚蠢。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=stupid&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>stupid</strong></a> mistake can have a serious cost even when it seems ridiculous in hindsight.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">愚蠢的错误即使事后看来可笑，也可能造成严重代价。</p></li>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="21-377">
<summary><h4 id="word-21-377" class="vocabulary-word-title">awkward<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-21-377" aria-label="定位 awkward">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="21-377" data-mark-label="awkward" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="awkward：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="awkward：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=awkward&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 awkward" title="在有道查询 awkward">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">21-377</span></span></summary>
<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">adj.笨拙的；尴尬的；棘手的；不合适的</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A careless movement made the clumsy waiter drop the tray, creating an <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=awkward&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>awkward</strong></a> silence.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">一个粗心的动作让笨手笨脚的服务员掉了托盘，造成尴尬的沉默。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=awkward&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>awkward</strong></a> arrangement left even a careful worker looking clumsy and careless.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">不方便的布置让即使仔细的工人看起来也笨拙又粗心。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Her clumsy attempt to repair a careless remark made the conversation more <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=awkward&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>awkward</strong></a>.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">她笨拙地试图补救一句无心之言，却让谈话更加尴尬。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">an awkward silence</span> · 尴尬的沉默</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=coordination&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">coordination</a></span> · 协调</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=tact&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">tact</a></span> · 得体；圆通</li></ul>
</div>
</details>

<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">adj.笨拙的</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A careless movement made the <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=clumsy&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>clumsy</strong></a> waiter drop the tray, creating an awkward silence.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">一个粗心的动作让笨手笨脚的服务员掉了托盘，造成尴尬的沉默。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The awkward arrangement left even a careful worker looking <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=clumsy&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>clumsy</strong></a> and careless.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">不方便的布置让即使仔细的工人看起来也笨拙又粗心。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Her <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=clumsy&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>clumsy</strong></a> attempt to repair a careless remark made the conversation more awkward.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">她笨拙地试图补救一句无心之言，却让谈话更加尴尬。</p></li>
</ol>

<p class="vocabulary-meaning">adj.粗心的；无忧无虑的；淡漠的</p>

<ol class="vocabulary-examples">

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The awkward arrangement left even a careful worker looking clumsy and <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=careless&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>careless</strong></a>.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">不方便的布置让即使仔细的工人看起来也笨拙又粗心。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">Her clumsy attempt to repair a <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=careless&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>careless</strong></a> remark made the conversation more awkward.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">她笨拙地试图补救一句无心之言，却让谈话更加尴尬。</p></li>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="21-380">
<summary><h4 id="word-21-380" class="vocabulary-word-title">oblivious<a class="header-anchor" href="#word-21-380" aria-label="定位 oblivious">&#8203;</a></h4><button type="button" class="vocabulary-word-mark" data-mark-word="21-380" data-mark-label="oblivious" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="oblivious：红色，点击切换为绿色" title="oblivious：红色，点击切换为绿色">🔴</button><span class="vocabulary-word-tools"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link vocabulary-word-dictionary no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=oblivious&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="在有道查询 oblivious" title="在有道查询 oblivious">🌐</a><span class="vocabulary-word-id">21-380</span></span></summary>
<div class="vocabulary-word-content">
<p class="vocabulary-meaning">adj.不知道的，未注意的</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The naughty child seemed <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=oblivious&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>oblivious</strong></a> to how greedy he looked while taking every sweet.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">那个淘气的孩子拿走所有糖果，似乎没有意识到自己显得多么贪心。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The story follows a greedy shopkeeper who is <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=oblivious&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>oblivious</strong></a> to the naughty children playing tricks on him.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">故事讲述一位贪心的店主没有注意到淘气的孩子们正在捉弄他。</p></li>

<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The writer calls the character <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=slothful&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>slothful</strong></a>, although his sluggish movements may simply reflect fatigue.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">作者称这个人物懒散，尽管他缓慢的动作可能只是疲劳所致。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A sluggish economy does not mean that the people working in it are <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=slothful&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>slothful</strong></a>.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">经济发展迟缓并不意味着其中的工作者懒惰。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">The fable contrasts a <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=slothful&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>slothful</strong></a> ruler with an energetic servant frustrated by the court’s sluggish response.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">寓言将懒散的统治者与因朝廷反应迟钝而沮丧的精力充沛的仆人进行对比。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">a slothful character</span> · 懒散的人物</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">联想词</p><ul class="vocabulary-related"><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=lethargic&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">lethargic</a></span> · 无精打采的</li><li><span class="vocabulary-relation">同场景</span> <span lang="en"><a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=energetic&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">energetic</a></span> · 精力充沛的</li></ul>
</div>
</details>

<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=sluggish&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>sluggish</strong></a> economy does not mean that the people working in it are slothful.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">经济发展迟缓并不意味着其中的工作者懒惰。</p></li>

<details class="custom-block details vocabulary-word" data-word-id="21-386">

<p class="vocabulary-meaning">n.冲动，心血来潮</p>
<p class="vocabulary-label">例句</p>
<ol class="vocabulary-examples">
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">A stubborn <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=impulse&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>impulse</strong></a> to follow rigid rules prevented him from adapting.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">固执地遵循僵硬规则的冲动使他无法适应。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">She resisted the <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=impulse&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>impulse</strong></a> to impose a rigid plan on her stubborn team.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">她克制了将僵化计划强加给固执团队的冲动。</p></li>
<li><p class="vocabulary-example-en" lang="en">His stubborn insistence on a rigid schedule began with an <a class="vocabulary-dictionary-link no-icon" href="https://youdao.com/result?word=impulse&amp;lang=en" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>impulse</strong></a> to control every detail.</p><p class="vocabulary-example-zh" lang="zh-CN">他固执地坚持僵硬的日程安排，源自想控制每个细节的冲动。</p></li>
</ol>
<p class="vocabulary-label">常用搭配</p><p class="vocabulary-collocation"><span lang="en">on impulse</span> · 一时冲动</p>

### 本章 Language Takeaway

优先尝试主动说出的三个表达：

- **maintain a healthy lifestyle**：保持健康的生活方式；healthy 来自 health 的词族。
- **relieve pain**：缓解疼痛。
- **express gratitude**：表达感激；express 为补充动词。

### 串学示范｜自拟短文

A healthy lifestyle supports both physical and mental well-being. Regular sleep and exercise can form part of that lifestyle. When someone feels unwell, they may describe symptoms and seek medical care. Recovery also involves emotions: a patient may feel anxious, relieved or grateful as their condition changes.

**中文理解：** 健康的生活方式支持身心福祉，规律睡眠和运动可以成为其中一部分。感到不适时，人们可以描述症状并寻求医疗照护。康复也涉及情绪：患者可能随状况变化而焦虑、宽慰或感激。
